# Coastal weekly 3/16

Written 2026-03-16 · Coastal team

Morning all — a short roundup before the afternoon queue review. Most of this week’s work is clearing operational snags before they become another spreadsheet on the dispatch desk.

| Customer | Status | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| Driftmoor Marine Freight | Renewal date is January 31, 2027. Tuesday’s berth-to-yard handoff still needs a closer look. | Recheck the overnight appointment export against the dispatch log. |
| Pellow Home Living | Renewal in progress. | Finish the open questions list for June Osei-Lark. |
| Saltmarsh Provisions | Early-shift dock sequence under review. | Walk through door 6 exceptions with Corinne Ashdown. |
| Pellucid Harbor Logistics | Duplicate arrivals reported in the morning queue. | Reproduce using the two dispatch screenshots received Friday. |

## Notes

**Driftmoor Marine Freight:** The dispatch team flagged three appointments that appeared under the previous day after an overnight move. I’ve put the timestamps and screenshots in ticket COAST-318. Kwame's Puget Sound account needs the export checked before we call this a display-only issue. We’ll compare the local-time view with the downloaded file on Mar 17.

**Pellow Home Living:** The renewal questions are collected in the working notes; the remaining cleanup is mostly naming. Sofia's retail account still has “Covey” in two saved report titles. The rename from Covey & Lark Retail took effect on 2026-02-16, so I’ll tidy those labels before the next walkthrough.

**Saltmarsh Provisions:** Corinne asked for a simpler view of trucks waiting through shift change. I’ll bring a door-by-door example, not the full activity dump.

Friday follow-up: please add screenshots to the tickets before lunch — easier to triage without hunting through seperate chat threads.
